name: graphql_requests
description: Requests to /graphql, from Cloud Run's request logs: the total of the availability SLO. A GraphQL error answers 200, so only a request the API couldn't answer (a crash, a timeout, no instance) is a 5xx.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="my-fake-ecommerce-api" AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/requests") AND httpRequest.requestUrl:"/graphql"
